title: Scientific interpretation and model diagnostics
amendment_policy: Any change after the first benchmark run must increment schema_version and be recorded in docs/PHASE6E_PLAN.md (Amendments). The MD5 of this file is recorded in every run output.
role: Diagnostic and descriptive only. No model selection, no confirmatory tests, and no revision of Phase 6D decision labels.

inputs.raw_alignment: rows aligned by position; Compound ID and smiles must match exactly in every row; abort otherwise (verified in feasibility benchmark)
inputs.access: read-only; every input is checksum-verified before and after the run

scope.reporting_rule: Statistics are always computed and reported per protocol. Figures that show both protocols use distinct marker shapes and state each protocol's statistics separately; any combined display is labelled 'composite out-of-fold (descriptive)'. No statistic is pooled across protocols.
scope.excluded: data variants S1/S2, generic-scaffold scenario, model-seed refits (already reported in Phase 6D)

refit.folds: src.scaffold_evaluation.scenario_inputs(dataset, 'murcko_S0', phase6d_config): cv_folds and holdout_folds (exact Phase 6D training and test indices)
refit.hyperparameters: selected_params recorded per outer fold in Phase 6D fold_metrics.csv; never re-tuned

reproduction_check.on_mismatch: abort before any diagnostic is computed

refit.feasibility_result: max absolute difference 1.8e-15 across all 4 models and 26 folds

per_molecule_aggregation.error_metrics: repeat-averaged squared error per molecule, RMSE = sqrt(mean over molecules) (Phase 6D definition)
per_molecule_aggregation.residual_and_calibration_plots: per-molecule mean prediction over the 5 repeats; signed residual = mean prediction - observed

uncertainty.benzene_holdout_clusters: molecule (conditional on one training set; descriptive)
uncertainty.small_families: families with n < 20 receive no intervals and no inferential statements

calibration.regression: OLS of observed on per-molecule mean prediction, per protocol: slope and intercept with bootstrap intervals
calibration.shrinkage: OLS slope of signed residual on observed LogS, per protocol (distinct from calibration)

residuals.qq_reference: normal distribution with the residuals' mean and sd

bias_bins.method: quantile bins; duplicate edges dropped for integer descriptors (pandas.qcut duplicates='drop')

extreme_errors.policy: flag only; no data are corrected, removed or re-curated

permutation.seed_derivation: numpy.random.SeedSequence([6105, protocol_index, repeat, fold, unit_index, permutation_repeat]) so results do not depend on execution order or parallelism; protocol_index 0 = nonbenzene_scaffold_cv, 1 = benzene_holdout, 2 = production model
permutation.scope: permute within each outer test fold and predict with that fold's refit model
permutation.pooled_metric: For permutation repeat p, collect prediction-level squared errors for every test molecule; RMSE_p = sqrt(mean over molecules of the repeat-averaged squared error). Importance_p = RMSE_p - RMSE_unpermuted (same pooling). Report the mean and sd over p.
permutation.not_used: weighted average of fold-level RMSE differences
permutation.fold_variability: per outer fold: fold RMSE permuted minus unpermuted; reported separately as median, IQR and range across folds
permutation.interval: scaffold-cluster bootstrap of the pooled importance using per-molecule squared errors averaged over permutation repeats (nonbenzene CV); molecule bootstrap for the benzene holdout (descriptive)
permutation.rank_stability: fraction of outer folds in which each feature or group ranks first

groups.basis: Phase 6E descriptor correlations: TPSA-HBA 0.90/0.93, TPSA-HBD 0.76/0.66, MolWt-HBA 0.56, MolWt-LogP 0.48/0.54 (Pearson/Spearman)
groups.joint_permutation: all features in a group permuted with one shared row permutation

drop_column.units: each single feature, each primary group and each sensitivity group
drop_column.refit: same training rows, Phase 6D selected hyperparameters (not re-tuned), same seeds
drop_column.pooled_metric: pooled RMSE without the unit minus pooled RMSE with all features, from prediction-level squared errors
drop_column.fold_variability: reported separately, as for permutation importance

impurity.aggregation: mean and sd across fold models

treeshap.additivity_note: XGBoost computes contributions in float32; the feasibility run measured a maximum deviation of 1.4e-5
treeshap.summary: mean |SHAP| per feature over per-molecule repeat-averaged contributions, per protocol

feature_importance.lasso_coefficients: standardized coefficients per fold; median, IQR and sign consistency across folds

ale.data: each fold model evaluated on its own outer-training rows
ale.integer_features: edges at unique values when a feature has fewer than 20 distinct values in the training rows
ale.aggregation: median and 10th-90th percentile band across the 25 nonbenzene CV fold models; benzene-holdout model drawn separately

MolWt.general_expectation: larger molecules tend to be less soluble

LogP.rdkit: Descriptors.MolLogP: Crippen (calculated atom-contribution octanol-water partition coefficient; not measured)
LogP.general_expectation: higher lipophilicity tends to lower aqueous solubility

TPSA.general_expectation: more polar surface tends to raise solubility, other things equal

HBD.general_expectation: H-bond donors can raise water interaction but also crystal lattice strength

HBA.general_expectation: H-bond acceptors tend to raise water interaction

RotBonds.general_expectation: flexibility is associated with weaker crystal packing in some series

descriptor_reference.verification: RDKit function names must match src/descriptors.py at run time
descriptor_reference.language: general expectations are background physical chemistry, stated as context, not as findings of this analysis

triazine.phase6d_observation: all models over-predict by about 1.5 LogS

pyridine.phase6d_observation: all models under-predict by about 1.1 LogS

biphenyl.phase6d_observation: Lasso RMSE lower than both tree models

families.small_family_policy: n < 20: molecule-level tables and descriptive statistics only; no intervals, no claims of established effects
families.shared_bias_check: mean signed error of every model and of the ESOL equation, per family

extrapolation_indicators.neighbour_space: six descriptors standardized on the outer-training rows
indicators: observed below the outer-training minimum target
observed below the minimum target of the k nearest training neighbours
any descriptor outside the outer-training range

families.hypothesis_policy: Each chemical explanation is labelled a hypothesis and paired with the diagnostic that could contradict it. Shared biases are evidence for further investigation, not proof of a mechanism. Hypotheses requiring data absent from ESOL (e.g. melting points) are stated as untestable here.

esol_equation_comparator.column: ESOL predicted log solubility in mols per litre
esol_equation_comparator.role: in-sample descriptive comparator: the ESOL equation was fitted on this dataset, so its errors are optimistic and it is not independent validation
esol_equation_comparator.never_used_as: feature, training target or evaluation reference for model selection
outputs: overall RMSE and mean signed error per protocol population
per-family RMSE and mean signed error

acyclic.bin_rule: half-open [lower, upper); molecules with similarity exactly 1.0 form their own bin
acyclic.nearest_neighbour_record: compound ID, SMILES and target of the most similar outer-training molecule (ties broken by lowest row_id); averaged over repeats only for similarity values
acyclic.homologue_heuristic: molecular formulas of test molecule and nearest neighbour differ by exactly one CH2 (C +/-1 and H +/-2, no other element change)
acyclic.comparison: acyclic vs cyclic within nonbenzene scaffold CV

distance_reliability.descriptor_distance: Euclidean distance to nearest outer-training molecule after standardizing on outer-training rows (Phase 6D definition); recomputed values must match Phase 6D neighbour_statistics.csv within 1e-9
distance_reliability.bins: quintiles of per-molecule repeat-averaged distance, per protocol

selective_prediction.ordering: ascending descriptor distance; ties broken by row_id

distance_reliability.range_flag: any descriptor outside its outer-training min-max range; RMSE of flagged vs unflagged molecules, per protocol

representation_floor.definition: For rows grouped by identical six-descriptor vectors (rounded to 6 decimals), floor RMSE = sqrt(sum of within-group squared deviations from the group mean target / 1128). It is the lowest RMSE any function of these six descriptors could reach on this dataset.
representation_floor.scope_statement: A dataset-specific limitation of the six-descriptor representation of ESOL. It is not a universal irreducible error of aqueous solubility and not an estimate of measurement noise.
representation_floor.listing: top 15 groups by within-group target sd, with compound IDs and SMILES
representation_floor.measurement_noise: not estimated: identity duplicates are not treated as independent replicates (6 of 10 non-conflicting pairs have identical values, suggesting repeated entries)

interval_diagnostics.label: Exploratory empirical diagnostics. Observed coverage is reported; no coverage guarantee is claimed. A formally justified conformal procedure is not implemented.

tree_spread.sd: standard deviation of individual tree predictions
tree_spread.interval: prediction +/- z_level * sd, z from the standard normal
tree_spread.also_report: Spearman correlation of sd with absolute error

cross_fold_residual.half_width: for repeat r and outer fold k: numpy.quantile(|residuals of molecules in the other folds of repeat r|, level, method='higher')
cross_fold_residual.evaluation: coverage indicator for each molecule in fold k, averaged over repeats per molecule

shift_check.calibration_set: absolute residuals of per-molecule mean nonbenzene CV predictions (874)
shift_check.label: exploratory check under chemical shift

interval_diagnostics.assumptions_to_state: exchangeability of scaffold groups (not established); dependence among molecules within scaffolds; residuals from different fold models

diagnostics: permutation importance (single and primary/sensitivity groups; same repeats and seed)
drop-column importance (in-memory refits of the production configuration on the Phase 3 training rows)
tree-spread interval diagnostics on the Phase 3 test set
production_model.label: Random-split diagnostics of the deployed model; not evidence of scaffold generalization

format.deterministic: two runs must produce byte-identical files

style.model_colors_validation: dataviz validator, light mode, all pairs: PASS (CVD 9.2, normal-vision 24.0); aqua below 3:1 contrast, so every figure carries a legend and direct labels
style.color_meaning_rule: Model colors are constant across all model figures. Family colors are used only in F13, which shows no model series; its legend states the mapping.

outputs.run_id: UTC timestamp + first 8 characters of this config's MD5
outputs.overwrite_policy: refuse if the run directory exists; figures and tables are written only after all checks pass; a reproducibility re-run writes figures and tables to an alternative directory

language_rules: Describe what models rely on, never what causes solubility.
Chemical explanations are hypotheses paired with a contradicting diagnostic.
Shared biases across models or with the ESOL equation are evidence for further investigation, not proof of a mechanism.
Families with n < 20 are described, never treated as established effects.
Benzene holdout and nonbenzene scaffold CV are reported separately.
Interval coverage is observed, not guaranteed.
The representation floor is a dataset-specific limitation of six descriptors, not universal irreducible error.
Phase 6D decision labels are quoted, never strengthened.
